newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai 1997 GDP growth seen at 5.9 percent.
newsitem.headline: Thai 1997 GDP growth seen at 5.9 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand on Monday forecast that the gross domestic product for the whole of 1997 will grow 5.9 percent against 6.7 percent in 1996.
Rerngchai Marakanond, central bank governor, said the slowdown was due partly to budget cut as a part of more cautious fiscal policy.
But despite the budget cut, Thailand was still likely to face 23 billion baht in fiscal deficit for the fiscal 1996/97 (October-September), he said.
